SELECT 1 FROM sportovci s WHERE s.id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM coach_scope_grants g JOIN treneri cg_t ON cg_t.id=g.trainer_id AND cg_t.aktivni=1 JOIN staff_user_positions cg_p ON cg_p.trainer_id=g.trainer_id AND cg_p.position_code='coach' WHERE g.trainer_id=7 AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.valid_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((g.scope_kind='team' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM club_roster_members cm JOIN club_teams ct ON ct.id=cm.team_id WHERE cm.sportovec_id=s.id AND cm.team_id=g.scope_id AND cm.status='active' AND ct.status='active' AND cm.valid_from<=CURRENT_DATE AND (cm.valid_to IS NULL OR cm.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE)))))
SELECT id FROM sportovci WHERE id = ?

SELECT 1 FROM account_person_roles r JOIN verejni_uzivatele a ON a.id=r.account_id WHERE r.account_id=? AND r.sportovec_id=? AND r.relation_role IN ('self','guardian') AND r.status='approved' AND r.valid_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND a.aktivni=1 AND a.email_overeno=1 LIMIT 1

SELECT BINARY mz.typ AS typ,COUNT(*) AS num,MIN(BINARY CONCAT(IF(t.datum IS NULL,'100000000',CONCAT('0',LPAD(CAST(99991231-CAST(REPLACE(CAST(t.datum AS CHAR),'-','') AS UNSIGNED) AS CHAR),8,'0'))),LPAD(CAST(9223372036854775807-CAST(t.id AS DECIMAL(20,0)) AS CHAR),20,'0'),CONCAT(IF(tm.poradi IS NULL,'0','1'),LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(CAST(tm.poradi AS DECIMAL(20,0))+9223372036854775808,0) AS CHAR),20,'0')),LPAD(CAST(CAST(mz.id AS DECIMAL(20,0))+9223372036854775808 AS CHAR),20,'0'))) AS first_position FROM trenink_mereni tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id JOIN treninky t ON t.id=tm.trenink_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=? GROUP BY BINARY mz.typ ORDER BY first_position

SELECT tm.trenink_id,tm.poradi,mz.id AS mereni_id,mz.typ, mz.vzdalenost,mz.distance_unit,mz.cas,mz.prevod,mz.cvik_id,mz.segment_id, mz.vaha,mz.opakovani,mz.rpe,mz.poznamka AS mereni_poznamka, c.nazev AS cvik_nazev,seg.nazev AS segment_nazev,tm.trenink_datum FROM (SELECT tm.trenink_id,tm.poradi,tm.mereni_id,t.datum AS trenink_datum FROM (SELECT id FROM treninky ORDER BY datum DESC,id DESC LIMIT 64) recent STRAIGHT_JOIN treninky t ON t.id=recent.id STRAIGHT_JOIN trenink_mereni tm ON tm.trenink_id=t.id STRAIGHT_JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY t.datum DESC,t.id DESC,tm.poradi ASC,mz.id ASC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0) tm JOIN mereni_zaznamy mz ON mz.id=tm.mereni_id LEFT JOIN cviky c ON c.id=mz.cvik_id LEFT JOIN segmenty seg ON seg.id=mz.segment_id WHERE mz.sportovec_id=? ORDER BY tm.trenink_datum DESC,tm.trenink_id DESC,tm.poradi ASC,mz.id ASC

filesort.sort_key: min(cast(concat(if(t.datum is null,'100000000',concat('0',lpad(cast(99991231 - cast(replace(cast(t.datum as char charset utf8mb4),'-','') as unsigned) as char charset utf8mb4),8,'0'))),lpad(cast(9223372036854775807 - cast(t.`id` as decimal(20,0)) as char charset utf8mb4),20,'0'),concat(if(tm.poradi is null,'0','1'),lpad(cast(coalesce(cast(tm.poradi as decimal(20,0)) + 9223372036854775808,0) as char charset utf8mb4),20,'0')),lpad(cast(cast(mz.`id` as decimal(20,0)) + 9223372036854775808 as char charset utf8mb4),20,'0')) as char charset binary))
tm.trenink_datum desc, tm.trenink_id desc, tm.poradi, mz.`id`
t.datum desc, t.`id` desc, tm.poradi, mz.`id`
